flow.name: dispatch-notes-post-flow
flow.doc:description: Drops remision_orderId_n.csv into pendientes with the order's next sequence number and returns 201

set-variable.doc:description: Keeps the request: SFTP operations replace the payload

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INIT - Drop dispatch note, orderId: ' ++ vars.dispatchRequest.orderId ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the start of the drop with the order id

set-variable.doc:description: Read the order's notes, then write the next one

flow-ref.name: sftp-resilient-call-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Calls the SFTP through poc-resilience; raises SFTP_UNAVAILABLE when it fails or the circuit is open

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END - Drop dispatch note, file: ' ++ payload.fileName ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the name of the file dropped

flow.name: dispatch-notes-list-flow
flow.doc:description: Dispatch notes in one folder (PENDING, SIGNED or REJECTED) with their acknowledgment

flow-ref.name: sftp-resilient-call-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Calls the SFTP through poc-resilience; raises SFTP_UNAVAILABLE when it fails or the circuit is open

set-payload.doc:description: Dispatch notes of the folder (may be empty)

flow.name: dispatch-notes-get-flow
flow.doc:description: The order's dispatch note with the highest sequence number, in any folder; 404 when it has none

set-variable.doc:description: Order id taken from the path

flow-ref.name: sftp-resilient-call-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Calls the SFTP through poc-resilience; raises SFTP_UNAVAILABLE when it fails or the circuit is open

choice.doc:description: 404 when the order has no dispatch note (papi-orders reads it as ON_HOLD)

when.doc:description: No file of the order in any folder

raise-error.description: The order has no dispatch note

set-payload.doc:description: The dispatch note with the highest sequence number

sub-flow.name: sftp-resilient-call-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Runs vars.rsFlow through resilience-call with the source sftp; raises APP:SFTP_UNAVAILABLE when it fails

flow-ref.name: resilience-call
flow-ref.doc:description: Circuit breaker and one retry on connectivity; never raises, leaves vars.rsResult

choice.doc:description: Any SFTP failure, including an open circuit, is a retryable 503

when.doc:description: The SFTP failed or its circuit is open

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'WARN - SFTP call failed, reason: ' ++ (vars.rsResult.reason default '') ++ ' - ' ++ (vars.rsResult.message default '') ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the failure reason and detail (the consumer only gets the reason)

raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'The logistics SFTP is unavailable (' ++ (vars.rsResult.reason default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ')']

sub-flow.name: dispatch-notes-scan-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Lists the folders in vars.scanStatuses and returns their dispatch notes (of vars.scanOrderId, or all)

set-variable.doc:description: Status of the folder being listed

sftp:list.directoryPath: #[output application/java --- p('sftp.baseDir') ++ '/' ++ (if (vars.scanStatus == 'PENDING') p('sftp.folders.pending') else if (vars.scanStatus == 'SIGNED') p('sftp.folders.signed') else p('sftp.folders.rejected'))]

ee:transform.doc:description: Keeps the order's CSVs and acknowledgments of this folder

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import folderEntries from modules::dispatch output application/java --- vars.scanEntries ++ folderEntries(payload, vars.scanStatus, vars.scanOrderId)

foreach.doc:description: sftp:list only returns paths: each acknowledgment is read

set-variable.doc:description: Name of the acknowledgment being read

sftp:read.doc:description: Reads the acknowledgment logistics left next to the CSV

ee:transform.doc:description: One DispatchNote per CSV, joined with its acknowledgment

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toNotes from modules::dispatch output application/java --- toNotes(vars.scanEntries, vars.scanAcks)

sub-flow.name: dispatch-notes-write-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Finds the order's next sequence number, writes the CSV as .tmp and renames it (never overwrites)

set-variable.doc:description: The sequence counts the order's notes in the three folders
Only the notes of this order

flow-ref.name: dispatch-notes-scan-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Existing dispatch notes of the order

ee:transform.doc:description: Next sequence number, file name and dispatch note to return

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import nextSequence from modules::dispatch output application/java var n = nextSequence(payload) var orderId = vars.dispatchRequest.orderId --- { dispatchNoteId: orderId ++ "-" ++ n, orderId: orderId, sequence: n, fileName: "remision_" ++ orderId ++ "_" ++ n ++ ".csv", status: "PENDING", depositedAt: (now() >> "UTC") as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"} }

ee:transform.doc:description: The CSV logistics reads: one row per line with order, note, customer and address

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/csv header=true, encoding="UTF-8" var r = vars.dispatchRequest var a = r.customer.address --- r.lines map ((l) -> { pedido: r.orderId, remision: vars.newNote.dispatchNoteId, cliente: r.customer.name, calle: a.street default "", ciudad: a.city, estado: a.state default "", codigo_postal: a.postalCode default "", sku: l.sku, cantidad: l.quantity })

sftp:write.doc:description: Writes the CSV as .tmp: logistics ignores it until it is renamed

sftp:rename.doc:description: Gives the file its final name; never overwrites an existing dispatch note
